tagline: Taking pollution interventions to defensible insights, faster.
scope: Public portfolio artifact built from retained GreenSeer evidence and model outputs.

metrics.meaning: EPA ambient monitoring sites represented in the retained archive

workflow.name: Evidence
workflow.description: Collect documents, source records and monitoring observations.

workflow.name: Interpret
workflow.description: Structure the intervention mechanism, place and timing.

workflow.name: Verify
workflow.description: Apply eligibility checks and governed routing rules.

workflow.name: Model
workflow.description: Compare approved methods on the same evaluation period.

workflow.name: Explain
workflow.description: Report results, provenance and claim boundaries.

cases.title: W H Sammis — unit 1 SO₂ scrubber startup
cases.place: W H Sammis, Jefferson County, Ohio
cases.outcome: Source SO2 mass per unit of fuel energy
cases.interpretation: Source intensity fell at unit1; other factors may have contributed. This is not an86.82% decline in surrounding air pollution.
cases.claim_boundary: Observed sulfur-dioxide emissions intensity at one generating unit; not ambient concentration or a causal effect.

cases.title: Fairbanks area: tighter winter wood-burning alerts
cases.place: Fairbanks North Star Borough nonattainment area; selected monitor only
cases.interpretation: Fine particles did not decline across these sampled winters. Weather and concurrent changes prevent attributing the difference to the rule.
cases.claim_boundary: This retained comparison is descriptive; it does not by itself identify a causal policy effect.

cases.title: Eureka replaced a diesel school bus and documented a year of electric operation
cases.place: Eureka City Schools, Eureka, Humboldt County, California, United States
cases.outcome: Reported fleet activity and conditional operating-cost accounting
cases.interpretation: One completed bus replacement has reported operating data. Exhaust reductions remain the district’s engineering estimates, not measured ambient improvements.
cases.claim_boundary: This retained comparison is descriptive; it does not by itself identify a causal policy effect.

cases.title: Shenango coke closure: nearby sulfur dioxide observations
cases.place: Neville Island / Avalon, Allegheny County, Pennsylvania
cases.interpretation: The reported monitor channel recorded lower SO₂ after closure. A single baseline year and unresolved original monitor siting limit interpretation.
cases.claim_boundary: This retained comparison is descriptive; it does not by itself identify a causal policy effect.

disclosures: GreenSeer is auto-ML inspired: routing is governed and auditable, not an unrestricted autonomous model generator.
Observed source changes, ambient changes, predictive explanations and causal effects are different evidence types.
The public site contains compact derived tables, not the full private data archive or SAS Viya environment.
